applicability: Opening recorded family and invariant subjects from family/member navigation in the normal reviewer.
conditions: The roster provides the member canonical invariant identity.
The clicked family and revision remain navigation context while the existing reader obtains the selected subject payload.
exclusions: An unaddressable roster member remains explicit context and cannot reuse another subject judgment.
The browser does not choose dataset paths or revision heads.
statement: A reviewer opens a recorded family or invariant through the existing subject reader, and a family member selection uses its canonical invariant identity while retaining the family and revision as navigation context.
